answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 158 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the sparrow challenge, the mesa audit can replay the inlet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2359 identities would post 4013 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
